Not quite yet. The summary is accurate for what we explored, but a few important parts still need to be included in this scope before building:

- Sorting by date or title, choosing my default sort, choosing how many items are shown, and adjusting text size shouldn’t wait for a later cycle.
- I need to select several bookmarks—or everything matching the current search, tags, or view—and add/remove tags, mark read/unread, archive, or delete them together.
- I want a saved local copy of a page so it remains available if the original changes or disappears. For a PDF, save the PDF itself. I’d also like an option to preserve it through the Internet Archive.
- I want to save a useful combination of search text and included or excluded tags as a named reusable view.
- I need to import and export standard browser bookmark files, retaining titles, tags, and original saved dates when importing.

Also, advanced search uses parentheses for grouping, not “brackets.” The automatic by-website view can wait, but the items above are part of the app I want. Please explore those before we settle the build scope.
